author: darthgizmothepup-eng
description: Chat with your own Muse from inside iNiR through the Muse Gadget SDK: messages go to your Muse, with your memory and your chats, not a raw model. In the other direction, your Muse can act on this iNiR install through the Gadget SDK service running on this computer, with an optional whitelisted inir.panel command that can only toggle, open or close panels. The plugin itself holds no SDK token and no API key: pairing is done once per computer, by its owner, in the Muse app.
name: Muse
summary: Chat with your Muse from iNiR, and let your Muse act on your iNiR install
